Plugin.name: ScheduledRestart
Plugin.Author: imaximum.tech
Plugin.Description: Daily timed server restarts with in-game warnings (10 min, 1 min) and a final countdown, world save before shutdown, and a command lockdown during the final window. Coordinates with the Discord bot over a shared MySQL database: publishes live player count + next-restart status, posts announcements, and accepts emergency /restart and /restart cancel from Discord. Provider.shutdown() only exits the process; the host (e.g. the panel's auto-restart) brings it back.
